description:
What this is. Overtime is normally recorded one person at a time. This does a whole group in one go — a department over a range of dates — and produces an overtime slip for each of them.

What to do. Choose the company, department and the dates worked, say how many hours and why, then submit. The individual slips are created for you.

Where to find it. Bulk Overtime in the menu on the left.
name: Run a Bulk Overtime Batch
title: Bulk Overtime — pay overtime for a group
